claim: Chatbot PII flow: typed text, full history and user-info tool data (name, address, email, phone) sent to an external AI service with no redaction, consent notice or minimisation
limitation: data flow traced end to end: Chatbot.razor:107 builds ChatState with the signed-in principal; AddUserMessageAsync appends typed text (:72) and sends the whole Messages list, system prompt included, to the chat client (:78); Messages.AddMessages(response) at :81 keeps tool exchanges so tool output is re-sent every turn; GetUserInfo is registered as a model-callable tool (:43) and returns name, last name, street, city, state, zip, country, email, phone from claims (:99-111), which ProfileService issues (:64-113) and WebApp reads via userinfo (Extensions.cs:81); card claims exist but the tool does not read them; chat client is built from chatModel (OpenAI/Foundry) or Ollama and wrapped with UseFunctionInvocation (:94-108); grep of WebApp finds no redaction, consent or privacy text except dead footer anchors (FooterBar.razor:66-67); document omits last name and zip but says name and address; anonymous users get empty values; model-initiated tool call is inferred from the registration; external destination applies to Foundry only (Ollama local), region and terms unknown (Q-4)

claim: Assistant output rendered as HTML image tags with model-controlled source URL, can leak chat context to a third-party host
limitation: src is HTML-encoded (no markup injection) but not restricted to the site; regex makes the leading ! optional so plain markdown links also become img tags; both user and assistant messages pass through AllowImages; no Content-Security-Policy in WebApp (grep; only Identity has one); leakage requires the model to emit a URL carrying data (prompt injection), inferred

claim: Webhook subscription makes the server call user-supplied URLs with no destination restriction
limitation: only checks are well-formed URI, event name and same scheme/host/port between two caller-supplied values; the OPTIONS probe succeeds only if the target returns a success status and echoes the token header, so the target must cooperate (a little stronger than 'answers'); later deliveries POST to DestUrl without that echo

claim: Webhook events go to every subscriber of the type, not the order owner
limitation: retriever filters on Type only; buyer name is in the shipped event only, the paid event carries order id and stock items (OrderStatusChangedToPaidIntegrationEvent.cs:3), so the buyer-name impact applies to shipped hooks

claim: Unknowns that must not be treated as controls: all 18 control rows
limitation: every item checked, none failed. TLS for the storefront (Present): HSTS outside Development and HttpsRedirection are middleware only; actual listener or ingress TLS and the http launch profile used for CI (AppHost.cs:22) are not asserted. TLS between services: plain http addresses (Extensions.cs:31) and RequireHttpsMetadata=false (:39) confirmed. CSRF: UseAntiforgery (Program.cs:24), ValidateAntiForgeryToken on Login/Logout, antiforgery.ValidateRequestAsync on webhook client logout confirmed. MFA: only TwoFactor view-model members; no sign-in use (grep TwoFactor). Cookie flags: only ExpireTimeSpan set. Rate limiting: no AddRateLimiter/UseRateLimiter anywhere in src (grep). Account lockout (Present): lockoutOnFailure flag, thresholds are framework defaults. Audit-log integrity: events enabled at Program.cs:23-26 only. Backup: no 'backup' hit in src, .github or README other than Android manifests. Production secret management: README.md:99-101 local only. Catalog authentication, order owner checks, webhook destination restrictions: absent as stated. Dead-letter handling: ack on failure; the 'retry' is for consumers (publisher retry exists, :22). Chatbot PII safeguards: no redaction in ChatState and no consent or privacy notice in Chatbot.razor or WebApp; footer Privacy and Terms are anchors without href (FooterBar.razor:66-67); 'data-processing terms' cannot be verified absent from a repository, the document correctly says they are outside the Target. Picture confinement (Present): PhysicalFileProvider rooted at Pics plus test GetCatalogItemPicDoesNotServeFilesOutsidePics asserting NotFound for ../appsettings.json (:237-263); relies on framework path handling. Order input validation (Present): validator registered through ValidatorBehavior (Extensions.cs:40,45); but a card number under four characters throws earlier (V-15) and validation failures come back as Ok (V-12). Health endpoints (Present): MapHealthChecks only inside IsDevelopment (:115-125)

claim: Troubleshooting matrix: all thirteen symptom rows (Empty GUID, RequestId missing, Cancel failed, Ship failed, Invalid token, Invalid grant URL, Subscriptions not found, assistant not switched on, assistant apology, assistant login needed, picture missing, order stays in one status, service stops at startup)
limitation: each of the 13 items verified. Empty GUID: cancel and ship only; create answers 'RequestId is missing.' (:135) and the storefront always sends a GUID. Cancel/ship failures: domain exception is swallowed by the identified-command handler into false, then 500 problem. Invalid token: the /check endpoint (:28), while /webhook-received returns a bare BadRequest. Invalid grant URL also needs the echoed token (GrantUrlTesterService.cs:27). Not found: get-by-id (:32) and delete (:81) filter by caller. Assistant notice, apology text (:90) and login message (:147) match; the apology is fixed text with the error logged. Picture NotFound by design. Stuck order: handler failures acked and dropped. Startup: migration exceptions logged and rethrown from the hosted service start

claim: Order stays in one status: check event bus health and consumer logs; handler failures are logged and dropped; escalate when any order is stuck beyond the grace period
anchor: Even on exception we take the message off the queue.
limitation: the consumer catches every handler exception, logs it as a Warning 'Error Processing message' (:172) and acks (:180) with no dead-letter or retry, so a failed status event is lost; other causes (broker down, processor not running, grace period not elapsed) are not examined in this row; the grace-period length is configuration not read here
